policy: Review every closed candidate set. Select only when ASV wording or an explicit mapped textual note distinguishes a reading; otherwise mark underdetermined and retain the base fallback. The base candidate is the qere, which is what MACULA Hebrew projects; the alternative is the ketiv written in the Leningrad Codex.

decisions.evidence: ASV reads 'Jehovah deal kindly with you', a jussive of the verb whose subject, person and sense are identical under either reading; the qere consonants יעש and the ketiv יעשה differ only in whether the final he is written, so the English cannot distinguish them. RUT.1.8 carries no ASV note mapped to this unit. Underdetermined; the qere base fallback carries the projection.
